derivation_method: keyword frequency analysis + bigram analysis + manual inspection of 11,938 SpotifyCares interactions

intents.name: playback_issue
intents.description: Music stops, skips, shuffles incorrectly, buffers, or fails to play at all.
inclusion_criteria: Song stops mid-play or at end of track
Shuffle not working or playing in wrong order
Buffering, freezing, or spinning loader during playback
exclusion_criteria: App crashes entirely before playback starts (-> app_bug)
Downloaded songs won't play offline (-> download_offline)
Can't find a specific song to play (-> content_search)
representative_examples: when i have it on shuffle it turns off when the song is done and just plays in order
spotify keeps stopping after every song even though i have premium
music keeps buffering on wifi but works fine on data

intents.name: app_bug
intents.description: The Spotify app crashes, freezes, shows errors, won't open, or behaves unexpectedly after an update.
inclusion_criteria: App won't open or shows blank/black screen
Error messages or error codes displayed
App broken after an OS or Spotify update
UI glitches, missing buttons, or layout broken
exclusion_criteria: Playback-specific issues where app is open and running (-> playback_issue)
representative_examples: the app keeps crashing every time i open it since the latest update
getting a error code 4 whenever i try to load spotify
app is completely blank after updating to ios 11

intents.name: account_login
intents.description: Problems logging in, resetting passwords, linking/unlinking social accounts, or accessing an account.
inclusion_criteria: Can't log in or sign in
Forgot password or password reset not working
Two accounts merged or duplicate account
exclusion_criteria: Billing or subscription issues after login (-> premium_billing)
App crashes before login screen appears (-> app_bug)
representative_examples: i'm using my facebook account to log in but it keeps saying wrong password
i forgot the email i used to sign up and can't reset my password
my account got locked and i can't get back in

intents.name: premium_billing
intents.description: Questions or problems about Premium subscriptions, payments, charges, cancellations, refunds, or free trials.
inclusion_criteria: Premium features not working despite active subscription
exclusion_criteria: General app bugs unrelated to billing (-> app_bug)
representative_examples: i was charged twice this month for premium
i cancelled my subscription but i'm still being billed
my free trial ended but i never agreed to be charged

intents.name: download_offline
intents.description: Problems downloading songs/playlists for offline listening, syncing across devices, or storage issues.
inclusion_criteria: Downloaded songs disappear or get removed
representative_examples: i'm able to play the playlist on my computer but it won't sync to my phone
my downloaded songs keep disappearing every time i restart the app
offline mode says i have no songs even though i downloaded them

intents.name: content_search
intents.description: Can't find songs, albums, artists, or playlists; content missing from library; search not returning expected results.
inclusion_criteria: Song, album, or artist not appearing in search
Content available in one region but not another
Library not showing recently added content
exclusion_criteria: Playback issues after finding content (-> playback_issue)
representative_examples: there is no way to manage Albums in the App, recently added ones don't show
i can't find this album on spotify but it's on apple music
my playlist disappeared and i can't find it anywhere

intents.name: general_inquiry
intents.description: General questions about Spotify features, how-to questions, feedback, or messages that don't fit a specific problem category.
inclusion_criteria: Questions about availability in a country/region
exclusion_criteria: Any message describing a specific technical problem (-> appropriate specific intent)
Messages that genuinely don't fit any category (-> other)
representative_examples: can you make it a feature that i can enable crossfade on mobile
is spotify available in india yet
love the new update, just wanted to say thanks

intents.name: other
intents.description: Messages that do not fit any of the 7 support intents. Includes off-topic messages, messages addressed to the wrong brand, spam, pure URLs with no text, or messages so short and context-free that no intent can be assigned.
inclusion_criteria: Message is not about Spotify at all
Message is addressed to a different brand
Standalone one-word replies with no context (e.g. 'yes', 'ok', 'no')
Pure URL with no accompanying text
exclusion_criteria: Short follow-up messages where the underlying issue can be inferred (-> inferred intent)
Vague messages that are clearly about a Spotify problem (-> general_inquiry)
representative_examples: yes
ok
https://t.co/xxxxxx
intents.routing_rationale: Cannot determine intent safely; human review required.
